svg.title: No record or grade below expected level
svg.desc: No record or grade below expected level. Historical definition. Adjusted descriptive difference (pp): no record the next year or grade below expected progression. Unknown grade excluded. Nominal uncertainty intervals: annual 95%; pooled 98.75%. 2005: +5.7 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2006: +11.3 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2007: +8.0 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2008: +2.9 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2009: +9.9 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2010: +27.2 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2011: +11.8 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2012: +10.5 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI; 2013: +7.0 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI; 2014: +7.8 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI; 2015: +8.9 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; pooled: +9.6 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI. Period-specific scale; do not compare lengths across panels. † Weak precision or no valid interval.
